qualification.details: Lab Technician Gr-III: CMLT/DMLT in any institution recognized by the Director of Medical Education. Occupational Therapist (DEIC): Bachelors / Master's degree in Occupational Therapy from a recognized university. District Programme Manager: Minimum Bachelor Degree (BAMS) from recognized university with Working Experience in Organizations Working in Public Health. Exposure in Social Sector Schemes/Mission of Government at National, State and district level and Knowledge of Computers Including MS office, MS Word, MS Powerpoint, MS Excel would be Given to Persons having PG Qualifications AYUSH Stream and Experience of Working in Health Sector including AYUSH. RMNCH+A Counsellor (Female Candidate only): Master's/ Bachelor's degree in Social Work / Public Administration/ Psychology / Sociology / Home Science/ Hospital & Health Management. 1-2 years work experience in Health Sector / relevant field. Assistant cum Data Entry Operator/DEO: Any Degree with computer knowledge (one year experience preferable). ULB-UHN/ANM: Higher Secondary School Examination and Two year ANM course by DPH approved Institutions. Cleaner: 8th Std Pass (Able to read and write in Tamil).

content_sections.heading: DHS Coimbatore Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 85 vacancies are available - 3 for Lab Technician Gr-III, 1 for Occupational Therapist (DEIC), 1 for District Programme Manager, 2 for RMNCH+A Counsellor (Female Candidate only), 1 for Assistant cum Data Entry Operator/DEO, 75 for ULB-UHN/ANM, and 2 for Cleaner.

content_sections.heading: DHS Coimbatore Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Lab Technician Gr-III: CMLT/DMLT in any institution recognized by the Director of Medical Education. Occupational Therapist (DEIC): Bachelors / Master's degree in Occupational Therapy from a recognized university. District Programme Manager: Minimum Bachelor Degree (BAMS) from recognized university with Working Experience in Organizations Working in Public Health. Exposure in Social Sector Schemes/Mission of Government at National, State and district level and Knowledge of Computers Including MS office, MS Word, MS Powerpoint, MS Excel would be Given to Persons having PG Qualifications AYUSH Stream and Experience of Working in Health Sector including AYUSH. RMNCH+A Counsellor (Female Candidate only): Master's/ Bachelor's degree in Social Work / Public Administration/ Psychology / Sociology / Home Science/ Hospital & Health Management. 1-2 years work experience in Health Sector / relevant field. Assistant cum Data Entry Operator/DEO: Any Degree with computer knowledge (one year experience preferable). ULB-UHN/ANM: Higher Secondary School Examination and Two year ANM course by DPH approved Institutions. Cleaner: 8th Std Pass (Able to read and write in Tamil).

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DHS Coimbatore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the District Health Society Coimbatore recruitment is 15th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DHS Coimbatore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: District Health Society Coimbatore has announced a total of 85 vacancies for various posts. These positions are spread across different roles within the healthcare sector.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Cleaner post?
faq.answer: For the Cleaner position, candidates must have passed the 8th standard and be able to read and write in Tamil. This is the minimum educational requirement for this role.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary range for the posts announced by DHS Coimbatore?
faq.answer: The salaries for the various posts range from Rs. 11,000/- to Rs. 42,000/- per month. The specific salary depends on the post for which the candidate is selected.

faq.question: Q5. Can candidates from other states apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not explicitly mention restrictions for candidates from other states. However, it is advisable to check the detailed eligibility criteria in the official notification PDF for any specific state-related requirements.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for DHS Coimbatore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it via post or direct submission to the specified address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for the District Programme Manager post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the District Programme Manager post is 59 years. This is one of the higher age limits specified for the announced vacancies.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for DHS Coimbatore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As per the information available, there is no application fee mentioned for any of the posts in the DHS Coimbatore Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form for DHS Coimbatore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of District Health Society Coimbatore, which is https://Coimbatore.nic.in. Make sure to download the form from the authorized source.

faq.answer: The job type for all the announced positions in the District Health Society Coimbatore recruitment is contractual. This means the employment will be on a contract basis.
